# Two html instance factories that built or rendered wrong, executed in a
# real Chromium.
#
# method.sngl: a component built at run time whose body declares a func. The
# factory emitted it as `function bump(this)`, which esbuild refuses, and the
# call as `Card_bump(state)`, a page function reading cells only the factory
# holds. Each card bumps itself once on mount, so both read 1.
#
# order.sngl: a reactive `if` in an instance body, followed by siblings. Its
# slot rendered into the parent with nothing to insert before, so the node it
# rendered on re-render landed after `after`, and one at the root of the body
# landed before `before` on the first render. Each slot now has its own
# anchor where it was written.


env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=html method.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep '<span>a 1</span>.*<span>b 1</span>' method.sngl.snapshots/bumped.html

sngl test --platform=html order.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep 'before a</span>.*on a</span>.*after a</span>' order.sngl.snapshots/boxed.html
grep 'before a</span>.*on a</span>.*after a</span>' order.sngl.snapshots/root.html

-- method.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component Card(label string) node {
    var hits = 0

    func bump() {
        hits = hits + 1
    }

    vbox {
        text(value="{label} {hits}")
        effect(@mount { bump() })
    }
}

component main node {
    var items = ["a", "b"]

    vbox {
        for var it = items {
            Card(label=it)
        }
    }
}

func testBumped(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("bumped")
}

window {
    main
}
-- order.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component Boxed(label string, on bool) node {
    var n = 0

    vbox {
        text(value="before {label}")
        if on {
            text(value="on {label}")
        }
        text(value="after {label}")
    }
}

component Rooted(label string, on bool) node {
    var n = 0

    text(value="before {label}")
    if on {
        text(value="on {label}")
    }
    text(value="after {label}")
}

component main node {
    var items = ["a"]
    var on = false

    vbox {
        button #flip(text="flip", @click { on = !on })
        for var it = items {
            Boxed(label=it, on=on)
        }
    }
}

component rootMain node {
    var items = ["a"]
    var on = true

    vbox {
        for var it = items {
            Rooted(label=it, on=on)
        }
    }
}

func testBoxed(t Test, c main) {
    c.flip.click()
    t.snapshot("boxed")
}

func testRoot(t Test, c rootMain) {
    t.snapshot("root")
}

window {
    main
    rootMain
}
